Neuroplasticity is the brain's ability to form new neural pathways. This biological
mechanism is what makes habit formation possible. When you repeat a behavior,
your brain physically rewires itself to make that behavior more automatic.
• Design your environment to support the habits you want to form
• Use spaced repetition to strengthen neural pathways
• Practice consistently for 66 days to cement new behaviors
